hook.say: Flat maps stretch everything near the poles. Can you still tell which is bigger? Five duels, three seconds each!

outro.say: How many did you get? Comment your score!

questions.q: Which is bigger: Greenland or Australia?
questions.fact: Australia is more than three and a half times the size of Greenland.
questions.sayAnswer: Australia! It is more than three and a half times the size of Greenland.

questions.q: Which is bigger: Madagascar or Sweden?
questions.fact: Madagascar is about 30% bigger than Sweden.
questions.sayAnswer: Madagascar! It is about thirty percent bigger than Sweden.

questions.q: Which is bigger: UK or New Zealand?
questions.say: Which is bigger: the U K or New Zealand?
questions.fact: New Zealand is about 10% bigger than the United Kingdom.
questions.sayAnswer: New Zealand! It is about ten percent bigger than the United Kingdom.

questions.q: Which is bigger: Mexico or Alaska?
questions.fact: Mexico is about 14% bigger than Alaska, the largest US state.
questions.sayAnswer: Mexico! It is about fourteen percent bigger than Alaska, the largest U S state.

questions.q: Which is bigger: Greenland or DR Congo?
questions.say: Which is bigger: Greenland or the Democratic Republic of the Congo?
questions.fact: DR Congo is 8% bigger than Greenland, yet looks tiny next to it on maps.
questions.sayAnswer: The D R Congo! It is eight percent bigger than Greenland, yet it looks tiny next to it on flat maps.
